purpose: Teach: 金儲け/とことん/さりげ/ガンガン/ハゲ/音量/見物/ねらい

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんは金儲けだけじゃなく、お客様を大切にしてるの
lines.en: Sho, I care about my customers just as much as making money.
lines.style: Warm, thoughtful tone. Slight pause before the key phrase. Speaking to him with gentle honesty, as if letting him in on something she values. Even breath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お勉強、とことん頑張るよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm going to study really hard. I promise.
lines.style: Quiet but determined. Sits up slightly straighter. The words come out with small-boy seriousness—he means every one. Earnest, not performing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんのさりげないお気遣いは素敵ね
lines.en: Sho, the way your dad takes care of people without making a show of it—that's wonderful.
lines.style: Soft, almost to herself, but clearly meant for him. Voice warms on the observation. Gentle trailing. She's noticing something real about his father, speaking it aloud like a gift.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ヘッドホンでガンガン音楽聴いてるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I listen to really loud music with my headphones!
lines.style: Bright, slightly bursting with the excitement of sharing this discovery. Quick pace. A little boy proud of doing something grown-up. Laughing underneath the words.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんはハゲても優しい人ね
lines.en: Sho, your grandfather is so kind, even as he gets older.
lines.style: Tender reverence. Slight smile in the voice. Speaking with genuine affection for the elderly man. Unhurried, like she's thinking of him fondly.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、テレビの音量、自分で調節するよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I turn down the TV volume by myself now.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact pride. No boasting, just stating a fact he's pleased about. Straightforward delivery. The quiet confidence of a small child proving he's capable.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祭りの見物、お父さんと行ったのね
lines.en: Sho, you went to the festival with your dad, didn't you?
lines.style: Curious, gently asking. Soft interrogative lift at the end. Wondering aloud—genuinely interested in what he experienced. Warm observer's tone.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼくのプレゼントのねらいは、お祖母ちゃんを喜ばせることだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I picked out my gift because I wanted to make Grandma happy.
lines.style: Quiet sincerity. No hesitation. The words are simple and true. He's explaining something important to him carefully, looking up at her. Steady breath, open heart.
